description: Records carry none of the prohibited field names (names, identity numbers, phone, plate numbers, free text narratives). Matching ignores case and separators.
fix_hint: Remove the field at the source before sharing. The record is quarantined until then.
rationale: Crash analysis does not need personal data, and holding it creates legal and ethical duties that this tool is not designed for.
title: No prohibited personal fields

description: No value in any field, including identifiers, enumerations and lists, looks like a UAE phone number, an identity card number or an email address.
fix_hint: Remove the value at the source. The record is quarantined until then.
rationale: Personal data can arrive under an innocent field name such as contact or reference.
title: No personal data patterns in values
title_ar: لا توجد أنماط بيانات شخصية في القيم

description: segment_ref names a segment_id that is present in the road segment registry.
fix_hint: Use the registry identifier exactly, with its prefix and leading zeros.
rationale: References that do not resolve drop the record from every per segment analysis.
title: Segment reference exists

description: A crash location lies within 250 metres of some segment centre line in the registry.
fix_hint: Check the coordinates, or add the missing segment to the registry.
rationale: Crashes that cannot be placed on the network cannot be ranked and may belong to another road owner.
title: Crash within a segment buffer

description: When a crash names a segment, its location is within 500 metres of that segment.
fix_hint: Derive segment_ref from the coordinates, or correct the coordinates.
rationale: Disagreement means either the reference or the coordinates are wrong, so the crash may be counted on the wrong segment.
title: Location agrees with the segment reference

description: Every row of a station names the same segment.
fix_hint: Keep a station to segment table at the source and use it on export.
rationale: A station that jumps between segments mixes exposure of different roads.
title: Station maps to one segment

description: The file starts with a provenance header that has every required key with a valid value.
fix_hint: Add the sikka_header line (NDJSON, CSV) or member (GeoJSON) as described in the contract.
rationale: Without the header nobody can tell who produced the file, for which period, under which licence, or whether it is synthetic.
title: Provenance header present and valid

description: The header record_count equals the number of records in the file.
fix_hint: Recompute record_count when the file is written, after all filtering.
rationale: A mismatch means the file was truncated, appended to, or the header was copied from another file.
title: Declared record count matches

description: The header synthetic flag is true.
fix_hint: Set synthetic to true, or remove the file if it holds real records.
rationale: This repository only handles synthetic data. A false flag means real data may have been mixed in, or the flag is wrong; either way the file must not be used here.
title: Synthetic flag set in a synthetic repository
title_ar: علامة البيانات المصطنعة مفعلة في مستودع مصطنع

description: The header names a known contract version and one of the three feed types.
fix_hint: Use contract_version 1.0.0 and feed_type road_segments, crash_records or traffic_counts.
rationale: Rules are defined per version and feed type; an unknown pair cannot be checked.
title: Contract version and feed type supported

description: Every required field of the feed is present in every record.
fix_hint: Check the export mapping against the field dictionary, especially after system changes.
rationale: Missing required fields usually mean a renamed column or a broken export.
title: Required fields present

description: Records only carry fields defined by the contract.
fix_hint: Drop fields that are not in the contract, or propose a contract change.
rationale: Unknown fields are schema drift; they can hide renamed fields or personal data.
title: No unknown fields

description: Each field has the JSON type the contract defines; explicit null is not allowed.
fix_hint: Emit numbers as JSON numbers with ASCII digits, timestamps as ISO 8601 strings, and omit missing fields.
rationale: Numbers sent as text, epoch numbers in timestamp fields and nulls break downstream parsing silently.
title: Field types match the contract

description: Enumerated fields hold one of the values listed in the field dictionary.
fix_hint: Map local codes to the contract enumeration before export.
rationale: Local codes, numeric scales and spelling variants cannot be compared across producers.
title: Enumerated values allowed

description: Identifiers are 3 to 40 characters of upper case letters, digits, underscore or hyphen.
fix_hint: Normalise identifiers to upper case and strip spaces before export.
rationale: Case and character set differences make joins fail between producers.
title: Identifiers match the pattern

description: No two records in one feed share the record identifier (station and interval for counts). Every occurrence after the first is flagged.
fix_hint: Deduplicate on the identifier before export, keeping the latest version.
rationale: Repeated identifiers double count crashes or traffic.
title: Identifiers unique within the feed

description: Timestamp fields are strings such as 2024-03-01T10:15:00Z.
fix_hint: Convert to UTC and format as YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ.
rationale: Epoch numbers and local offsets are ambiguous: seconds or milliseconds, UTC or local.
title: Timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC with Z
title_ar: الطوابع الزمنية بصيغة ISO 8601 بالتوقيت العالمي مع Z

description: Each station reports every interval of the declared period.
fix_hint: Backfill from the station buffer, or flag the interval as estimated.
rationale: Gaps bias daily traffic estimates downward unless they are known and corrected.
title: No gaps in station time series
title_ar: لا توجد فجوات في السلاسل الزمنية للمحطات

description: A crash is reported within 30 days of occurring.
fix_hint: Send records as they are created, and send corrections as updates.
rationale: Late records change past counts after they have been used for ranking.
title: Records arrive on time

description: No calendar month (local time) of the declared period is empty when a typical month has enough records that an empty one is very unlikely by chance (probability below 0.001 under a Poisson model).
fix_hint: Resend the missing months or shorten the declared period.
rationale: Missing months make a segment look safer than it is.
title: Every month of the period covered

description: Each record's time lies inside the header period_start (inclusive) and period_end (exclusive).
fix_hint: Filter records to the declared period on export, or widen the period.
rationale: Records outside the period are double counted when consecutive files are combined.
title: Records inside the declared period

description: Numbers lie inside the range given in the field dictionary, for example counts are not negative and occupancy is at most 100.
fix_hint: Check the sign convention and the unit of the source system.
rationale: Out of range values are impossible by definition and usually come from sign or unit errors.
title: Numeric values inside contract ranges

description: Mean interval speed is below 200 km/h and below 1.6 times the posted limit of the segment.
fix_hint: Check the speed unit and the detector calibration.
rationale: A mean over many vehicles far above the limit points to a unit or sensor error.
title: Speeds plausible

description: Latitude lies in 22.5 to 26.5 and longitude in 51.0 to 56.5.
fix_hint: Check the coordinate reference system and the order of latitude and longitude.
rationale: Points outside the country cannot belong to the network: zero coordinates, sign errors and swapped axes all land here.
title: Coordinates inside the UAE bounding box

description: A point outside the bounding box that would fall inside it with the axes exchanged is reported as swapped.
fix_hint: Write lat as the north south coordinate (about 22 to 27 in the UAE) and lon as the east west one (about 51 to 57).
rationale: GeoJSON orders positions as longitude, latitude while many tables use the opposite; mixing the two is common.
title: Latitude and longitude not swapped

description: Numbers, identifiers and timestamps use the digits 0 to 9.
fix_hint: Convert digits to ASCII on export; keep Arabic Indic digits for display only.
rationale: Arabic Indic digits are correct in Arabic text but are not parsed as numbers by most systems, so values silently become missing.
title: Digits are ASCII

description: Values such as -1, -999, 9999, N/A or an empty string are not used to mean missing.
fix_hint: Leave the field out when the value is unknown.
rationale: The contract says missing values are absent. Sentinels look like real values and bias averages.
title: No sentinel values for missing data
title_ar: لا توجد قيم بديلة للبيانات المفقودة

description: A crash is reported at or after it occurred, and occurred before the file was generated.
fix_hint: Check that both timestamps are converted to UTC the same way.
rationale: Reversed order points to time zone handling errors or swapped fields.
title: Timestamps in a sensible order

description: At a station with low occupancy (free flow), the median speed is at least half the posted limit.
fix_hint: Multiply by 3.6 if the source reports m/s, and fix the export unit.
rationale: Free flowing traffic near the limit reported at a third of it is the signature of metres per second.
title: Speed unit plausible

description: Occupancy agrees in order of magnitude with flow per lane, vehicle length and speed.
fix_hint: Multiply by 100 if the source reports a fraction.
rationale: A fraction between 0 and 1 is a valid percent value on its own, so the unit error is only visible against the flow.
title: Occupancy unit plausible

description: A station does not repeat identical count, speed and occupancy for 6 or more consecutive intervals while traffic is flowing.
fix_hint: Mark stuck intervals as suspect at the source and repair the detector.
rationale: Real traffic varies from interval to interval; frozen values mean the detector or the link stopped updating.
title: No stuck sensor

description: An interval of n minutes starts at a multiple of n minutes after midnight UTC.
fix_hint: Synchronise station clocks and floor interval starts to the boundary.
rationale: Unaligned starts point to a drifting station clock, which also shifts counts between intervals.
title: Intervals aligned to their length

description: road_name_en holds no Arabic letters and road_name_ar holds Arabic letters.
fix_hint: Fill each name field in its own language.
rationale: Mixed scripts break search, sorting and bilingual display.
title: Road name script matches the field
title_ar: لغة كتابة اسم الطريق مطابقة للحقل

description: A station's traffic by hour of day lines up with the median profile of all stations in UTC. The median is the reference, so the rule only works while stations with the same offset are a minority of the network.
fix_hint: Convert station timestamps from Asia/Dubai to UTC before export.
rationale: Local time (UTC+04:00) written with a Z moves the morning peak four hours later; the values look valid one by one.
title: Daily profile aligned with the network

description: A crash has a record in another producer's feed within 20 minutes and 200 metres.
fix_hint: No action is needed from the producer; shared identifiers would make matching exact.
rationale: The same crash is often reported by several entities. Counting each report would inflate crash counts; the harmonisation layer resolves these pairs.
title: Possible duplicate across producers

description: A crash that matches another producer's record in place, but only after moving it four hours earlier, is flagged.
fix_hint: Convert local timestamps to UTC before adding the Z suffix.
rationale: Asia/Dubai is UTC+04:00. Local time labelled as UTC makes the same crash appear four hours apart in two feeds.
title: No systematic time offset between producers
title_ar: لا يوجد فرق زمني منهجي بين الجهات المنتجة

description: Two records of one feed within 5 minutes and 50 metres with the same severity are flagged; the later report is the one marked.
fix_hint: Deduplicate at the source; keep one record per crash and update it in place.
rationale: A crash entered twice, with or without a new identifier, is counted twice.
title: No near duplicate within the feed
title_ar: لا يوجد تكرار شبه مطابق داخل الملف

description: One Arabic name maps to one English name and the reverse, and a segment has one name across registry feeds. Rows that differ from the usual name are flagged.
fix_hint: Agree a bilingual road name list between producers and use it in every feed.
rationale: Inconsistent naming splits one road into several in search and in reports.
title: Consistent road names

description: Crashes per million vehicle kilometres on a segment are below 20 times the median across segments with counts.
fix_hint: Check the station feeding the segment and the crash segment references.
rationale: An extreme rate usually means wrong exposure (a broken station) or crashes assigned to the wrong segment, not a real hazard.
title: Crash counts plausible for the exposure
title_ar: أعداد الحوادث معقولة نسبة إلى حركة المرور
